text.p: Westmark Group Holdings Inc said on Friday president Norman Birmingham had resigned.
The company said in a statement its board of directors had accepted his resignation, effective on September 10. He resigned to pursue business interests within and outside the holding company.
The company said it intends to announce an expanded board of directors, as well as a new president at its next regularly scheduled meeting.
Westmark said 519,242 shares of common stock had been returned to the treasury from agreements reached with various shareholders. The returns reduce the outstanding shares about 16.5 percent.
The statement also announced the largest loan sale in its history, to Household Finance Corp, part of the Household International Inc group. The sale amounted to $3.49 million.
